fullContentHtml:
RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the mains Result for the post of Assistant. This recruitment was released for 650 posts.. Applications for the RBI Assistant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 16, 2026, to March 10, 2026. The mains examination was conducted on 07 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 February 2026
  • Last Date : 10 March 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 March 2026
  • Correction Date : 14-15 March 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 11 & 13 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 02 April 2026
  • Result : 25 May 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 07 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 27 May 2026
  • Result : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 450/- (+GST Extra 18%)
  • SC, ST, PwBD, EXS : Rs. 50/- (+GST Extra 18%)

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
